rationale: The Chief Justice is likely to keep assignment or give it to Justice Kagan to produce a levy-centric, Article III redressability opinion distinguishing Reed and rejecting “preclusion-only” relief as insufficient in a § 6330 CDP case once the levy is abandoned. The dissent is most likely led by Justice Barrett (possibly with Justice Sotomayor and/or Justice Jackson writing or joining separately) emphasizing that § 6330(d)(1) authorizes review of the Appeals “determination” and that vacatur has concrete legal consequences beyond the withdrawn levy.
